design: predeclared one-feature-at-a-time information ablation of one existing constructed fixture
unit: exact answer set for one task on one fixture

tasks.question: Which states describe the risk, separately from its register workflow?
tasks.query:
PREFIX sr: <urn:semrisk:entity:>
PREFIX c: <urn:semrisk:scenario:p1:e2e:>
PREFIX b: <urn:semrisk:case:pharma:v1:>
PREFIX dct: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
SELECT ?family ?state WHERE { { b:risk-context sr:SR-REL-031 ?state . ?state a sr:SR-CPT-035 . BIND("risk" AS ?family) } UNION { c:entry sr:SR-REL-030 ?state . ?state a sr:SR-CPT-036 . BIND("workflow" AS ?family) } }
tasks.limitation: Asserted typed retrieval only; no new OWL non-entailment test or causal treatment-effect inference.

tasks.question: Which newer assessment and result supersede the earlier assessment and result for the same risk?
tasks.query:
PREFIX sr: <urn:semrisk:entity:>
PREFIX c: <urn:semrisk:scenario:p1:e2e:>
PREFIX b: <urn:semrisk:case:pharma:v1:>
PREFIX dct: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
SELECT ?new ?old ?newResult ?oldResult WHERE { ?new sr:SR-REL-034 ?old ; sr:SR-REL-013 ?risk ; sr:SR-REL-015 ?newResult . ?old sr:SR-REL-013 ?risk ; sr:SR-REL-015 ?oldResult . ?newResult sr:SR-REL-033 ?oldResult . }
tasks.limitation: Explicit historical links; no timestamp reasoning, score reduction or elapsed-time claim.

tasks.question: What qualified support role does the cited evidence have for each assessment result?
tasks.query:
PREFIX sr: <urn:semrisk:entity:>
PREFIX c: <urn:semrisk:scenario:p1:e2e:>
PREFIX b: <urn:semrisk:case:pharma:v1:>
PREFIX dct: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
SELECT ?result ?evidence ?role WHERE { ?result sr:SR-REL-017 ?evidence . ?statement a rdf:Statement ; rdf:subject ?result ; rdf:predicate sr:SR-REL-017 ; rdf:object ?evidence ; dct:type ?role . }
tasks.limitation: Contextual evidence is not evidence of a measured numerical treatment effect.

tasks.question: Which external CM-PharmE entities are linked to the risk?
tasks.query:
PREFIX sr: <urn:semrisk:entity:>
PREFIX c: <urn:semrisk:scenario:p1:e2e:>
PREFIX b: <urn:semrisk:case:pharma:v1:>
PREFIX dct: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
SELECT ?target WHERE { b:risk-context sr:SR-REL-037 ?target . }
tasks.limitation: Positive control of external identity retrieval, not validation of imported domain semantics.

acceptance: All full/restored answers match; each ablation changes exactly its declared task and preserves the other three. No runtime or peer-superiority claim.
